fusions.name: Shot From the Skirting
fusions.desc: Fires from cover at one enemy, dealing 34 damage that ignores armour.

fusions.name: Report and Rout
fusions.desc: A sharp crack sends your swarm bolting forward in a cone 4 tiles long; it deals 12 damage to each enemy in it and knocks each 3 tiles back.

fusions.name: Reload on the Run
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Scurry, Then Shoot
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
